title: Authentication
name: Name
inheritedFromWorkspace: The workspace carries the auth that applies.
redirectPortHelp: Empty picks a free port each time. Some providers only accept the one you register.
redirectUri: Register this redirect URI with the provider: {{uri}}
tokenMemoryOnly: Only in memory, this machine has no keychain: valid until {{time}}
describeInherit: Uses the auth of the level above.
describeBasic: Adds an Authorization header with the username and password encoded in Base64.
describeBearer: Adds an Authorization header with the token, after its prefix.
describeApiKey: Adds the key and its value where you choose.
describeOAuth2ClientCredentials: Gets a token from the provider with the client's own credentials and adds it as a Bearer token.
describeOAuth2CodePkce: Opens the provider's sign-in in the browser, gets a token and adds it as a Bearer token.
prefixHelp: Written before the token. Empty uses Bearer.
audienceHelp: Only for providers that ask for it.
describeDigest: Sends the request, answers the server's challenge with a hash of the username and password, and sends it again.
describeAwsV4: Signs the request with the access key and its secret, as AWS asks.
regionHelp: Empty reads it from the AWS host, or uses us-east-1.
serviceHelp: Empty reads it from the AWS host.
loopbackReceived: Mandor received the authorization. You can close this tab.
